<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have sent a message to Brad asking for a complete list of his partners' availability. I will now end my session to give him a chance to respond. In my next session, I expect to receive the list from Brad. At that point, I will have to do a four-way comparison of calendars to find a common slot. I have already retrieved the calendars for my partners, so I am prepared for this next step. My action of asking for the full availability is a good strategic move because it will avoid the back-and-forth of suggesting and rejecting individual slots. It's more efficient to get the complete picture. Ending my session now is the best way to move the task forward.
